items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 27 July 2026 11:41am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 27 July 2026 at 11:40am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred near the Azores. Low pressure over the Norwegian Sea, and a new shallow low developing to the south of Iceland.


##Wind##

Mainly southwest 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4 for a while tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Patchy outbreaks of light rain or drizzle developing, especially across the north of the area. Becoming mostly fair again by tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in precipitation.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 for a while later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mostly fair, just patchy light rain or drizzle mainly in northern parts.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in places.
